acquisition method: Data dependent acquisition was performed in profile and positive mode
cleavage agent: 100μL ABC buffer was added for trypsin digest.
collision energy: The top 10 most intense ions were fragmented by HCD with normalized collision energy (NCE) of 27%
enrichment method: These Na, K-ATPase α1 interacting proteins were screened by co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) technology.
fragmentation method: The top 10 most intense ions were fragmented by HCD
instrument: coupled to Q-Exactive mass spectrometry (Thermo Finnigan)
labeling: These proteins were pulled down for label-free mass spectrometry to understand the binding and interacting protein
